# BandWagon

> BandWagon is a free, privacy-first carpool coordination platform for school bands, sports teams, clubs, scout troops, faith groups, and other trusted community groups. Families in a group use it to request and offer seats for rehearsals, games, and events. It is funded by optional donations and local sponsors, and is made by Harrison Ward Technology.

Key facts:

- Free for organizations and families. No ride payments and no paid drivers.
- Not a rideshare company, taxi service, or school transportation. BandWagon does not provide, supervise, track, or guarantee rides. Families decide whether to accept each ride.
- Each organization runs its own private community (for example `<name>.bandwagon.club`) and sets its own driver requirements, such as license, insurance, minimum age, and admin approval. BandWagon does not run background checks or certify drivers.
- Guardians control student profiles. Students do not need accounts.
- No live GPS tracking, no ads, no ad trackers, and personal information is never sold. Sponsors never receive participant data.
- Works in any modern browser and can be installed on iOS and Android as a web app (PWA).

## Public pages

- [Home](https://bandwagon.club/): what BandWagon is, who it is for, how it works, and FAQ
- [Start a community](https://bandwagon.club/start): request a free community for your group
- [Help Center](https://bandwagon.club/help): guides for admins, parents, and drivers

## Not for crawling

Signed-in areas (`/app`, `/admin`), sign-in and invitation links, and community (tenant) sites other than their landing page contain private member information and are excluded from indexing. Please do not attempt to access them.
